dedupe_keys.name: county scale dataset of disaster effects on crops in taiwan 2003 2022

description: A dataset of crop damage from disasters in Taiwan with matching daily weather. The Scientific Data paper (published 14 February 2024) says the authors mined 9,245 damage records from 233 crop disaster observations in Taiwan's Report on Crop Production Loss Caused by Disasters for 2003 to 2022, covering multiple disasters, crops and affected regions, added disaster and crop classifications, and paired them with daily weather station data, all cleaned for quality. The data are free on figshare (doi 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.6989844.v1). Coverage is Taiwan by county. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. For simulation it gives observed crop losses by typhoon, heavy rain, cold or drought, to fit damage functions for agricultural impact models. A related catalogue record is the NFA Taiwan disaster case data.
